4.ar: أَبُوعَمْرٍو الزُّبَیْرِیُّ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَیُّهَا الْعَالِمُ أَخْبِرْنِی أَیُّ الْأَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ قَالَ: مَا لَا یَقْبَلُ اللَّهُ شَیْئاً إِلَّا بِهِ. قُلْتُ: وَ مَا هُوَ؟ قَال: الْإِیمَانُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِی لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ أَعْلَی الْأَعْمَالِ دَرَجَةً وَ أَشْرَفُهَا مَنْزِلَةً وَ أَسْنَاهَا حَظّاً. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: أَ لَا تُخْبِرُنِی عَنِ الْإِیمَانِ أَ قَوْلٌ هُوَ وَ عَمَلٌ أَمْ قَوْلٌ بِلَا عَمَلٍ؟ فَقَالَ: الْإِیمَانُ عَمَلٌ کُلُّهُ وَ الْقَوْلُ بَعْضُ ذَلِکَ الْعَمَلِ بِفَرْضٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ بَیَّنَ فِی کِتَابِهِ وَاضِحٍ نُورُهُ ثَابِتَةٍ حُجَّتُهُ یَشْهَدُ لَهُ بِهِ الْکِتَابُ وَ یَدْعُوهُ إِلَیْهِ. قَالَ: قُلْتُ: صِفْهُ لِی جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ حَتَّی أَفْهَمَهُ. قَالَ: الْإِیمَانُ حَالاتٌ وَ دَرَجَاتٌ وَ طَبَقَاتٌ وَ مَنَازِلُ فَمِنْهُ التَّامُّ الْمُنْتَهَی تَمَامُهُ وَ مِنْهُ النَّاقِصُ الْبَیِّنُ نُقْصَانُهُ وَ مِنْهُ الرَّاجِحُ الزَّائِدُ رُجْحَانُهُ. قُلْتُ: إِنَّ الْإِیمَانَ لَیَتِمُّ وَ یَنْقُصُ وَ یَزِیدُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ. قُلْتُ: کَیْفَ ذَلِکَ؟ قَالَ: لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی فَرَضَ الْإِیمَانَ عَلَی جَوَارِحِ ابْنِ آدَمَ وَ قَسَّمَهُ عَلَیْهَا وَ فَرَّقَهُ فِیهَا فَلَیْسَ مِنْ جَوَارِحِهِ جَارِحَةٌ إِلَّا وَ قَدْ وُکِّلَتْ مِنَ الْإِیمَانِ بِغَیْرِ مَا وُکِّلَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا ... فَمَنْ لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَافِظاً لِجَوَارِحِهِ مُوفِیاً کُلُ جَارِحَةٍ مِنْ جَوَارِحِهِ مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَیْهَا لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مُسْتَکْمِلًا لِإِیمَانِهِ وَ هُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ مَنْ خَانَ فِی شَیْءٍ مِنْهَا أَوْ تَعَدَّی مَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِیهَا لَقِیَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ نَاقِصَ الْإِیمَانِ. قُلْتُ: قَدْ فَهِمْتُ نُقْصَانَ الْإِیمَانِ وَ تَمَامَهُ. فَمِنْ أَیْنَ جَاءَتْ زِیَادَتُهُ؟ فَقَالَ: قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ إِذا ما أُنْزِلَتْ سُورَةٌ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ یَقُولُ أَیُّکُمْ زادَتْهُ هذِهِ إِیماناً فَأَمَّا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا فَزادَتْهُمْ إِیماناً وَ هُمْ یَسْتَبْشِرُونَ وَ أَمَّا الَّذِینَ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ مَرَضٌ فَزادَتْهُمْ رِجْساً إِلَی رِجْسِهِمْ وَ قَالَ نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَیْکَ نَبَأَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ إِنَّهُمْ فِتْیَةٌ آمَنُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ وَ زِدْناهُمْ هُدیً وَ لَوْ کَانَ کُلُّهُ وَاحِداً لَا زِیَادَةَ فِیهِ وَ لَا نُقْصَانَ لَمْ یَکُنْ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ فَضْلٌ عَلَی الْآخَرِ وَ لَاسْتَوَتِ النِّعَمُ فِیهِ وَ لَاسْتَوَی النَّاسُ وَ بَطَلَ التَّفْضِیلُ وَ لَکِنْ بِتَمَامِ الْإِیمَانِ دَخَلَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ بِالزِّیَادَةِ فِی الْإِیمَانِ تَفَاضَلَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِالدَّرَجَاتِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَ بِالنُّقْصَانِ دَخَلَ الْمُفَرِّطُونَ النَّار.
4.en: Abu ‘Amr al-Zubayri reported from Abu ‘Abd Allah (peace be upon him): I said to him, "O Scholar, inform me which deeds are best in the sight of Allah." He said, "That without which Allah does not accept anything." I asked, "And what is that?" He replied, "Faith in Allah, besides whom there is no god; it is the highest in degree, the most noble in station, and the most exalted in portion." I said, "Will you not inform me about faith? Is it speech and action, or speech without action?" He replied, "Faith is entirely action, and speech is a part of that action, by a mandate from Allah clearly stated in His Book, its light manifest, and its proof established; the Book bears witness to it and calls [the believer] toward it." I said, "Describe it to me, may I be made your sacrifice, so that I may understand it." He said, "Faith has states, degrees, strata, and stations. Some of it is complete, having reached its perfection; some of it is deficient, its deficiency being manifest; and some of it is superior, its superiority being in excess." I said, "So faith can be complete, deficient, and increased?" He said, "Yes." I said, "How is that?" He said, "Because Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, made faith obligatory upon the limbs of the son of Adam, divided it among them, and distributed it within them. There is no limb among his limbs that has not been entrusted with a portion of faith different from that which its sister has been entrusted with... So whoever meets Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, while guarding his limbs and fulfilling for every one of his limbs what Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has made obligatory upon it, he meets Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, having perfected his faith, and he is among the people of Paradise. And whoever betrays any part of them or transgresses what Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has commanded regarding them, he meets Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, with deficient faith." I said, "I have understood the deficiency and perfection of faith. But from where does its increase come?" He said, "The word of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: 'And whenever a surah is revealed, some of them say, "Which of you has this increased in faith?" As for those who believe, it has increased them in faith, while they rejoice. But as for those in whose hearts is a disease, it has added filth to their filth' (9:124-125). And He said: 'We relate to you their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance' (18:13). If it were all one thing, with no increase or decrease in it, no one would have any merit over another, the blessings within it would be equal, the people would be equal, and the concept of preference would be void. But it is through the perfection of faith that the believers enter Paradise, through the increase in faith that the believers are ranked in degrees before Allah, and through deficiency that the negligent enter the Fire."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 424

4.ar: لِیَزْدادُوا تَصْدِیقاً بِشَرَائِعِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَ هُوَ أَنَّهُمْ کُلَّمَا أُمِرُوا بِشَیْءٍ مِنِ الشَّرَائِعِ صَدَقُوا بِهِ وَ ذَلِکَ بالسَّکِینَة الَّتِی أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ فِی قُلُوبِهِمْ.
4.fa: تا تصدیق به شریعت اسلام افزون گردد و آن اینکه هرگاه به چیزی از احکام اسلامی امر شوند آن را تصدیق نموده و با آرامشی که خداوند در قلوب ایشان قرار داده آن را می‌پذیرند.
4.en: So that they may increase in their affirmation of the laws of Islam; this means that whenever they were commanded with any of the Islamic laws, they affirmed it, and that was through the tranquility (sakīnah) that Allah sent down into their hearts.
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 426

4.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ: قُلْنَا: یَا رَسُولَ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِنَّ الْإِیمَانَ یَزِیدُ وَ یَنْقُصُ؟ قَالَ: نَعَمْ، یَزِیدُ حَتَّی یُدْخِلَ صَاحِبَهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ یَنْقُصُ حَتَّی یُدْخِلَ صَاحِبَهُ النَّارَ.
4.fa: ابن‌عمر گوید: به رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) گفتیم: «آیا ایمان کم و زیاد می‌شود»؟ فرمود: «بله ایمان زیاد می‌گردد تا جایی که صاحبش را در بهشت داخل می‌نماید و کم می‌گردد تا جایی که صاحبش را وارد جهنّم می‌کند».
4.en: Ibn Umar said: We asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), "Does faith increase and decrease?" He replied, "Yes, it increases until it brings its possessor into Paradise, and it decreases until it brings its possessor into the Fire."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 426

4.ar: قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) یَقُولُونَ مِنَّا ثَمَانِیَةٌ مُحَدَّثُونَ سَابِعُهُمُ الْقَائِمُ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف)، فَقَامَ أَبُوبَصِیرٍ ابْنُ أَبِی الْقَاسِمِ فَقَبَّلَ رَأْسَهُ، وَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مِنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِینَ سَنَةً، فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُوبَصِیرٍ: سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) وَ إِنِّی کُنْتُ خُمَاسِیّاً جَاءَ بِهَذَا. قَالَ: اسْکُتْ یَا صَبِیُ لِیَزْدادُوا إِیماناً مَعَ إِیمانِهِمْ یَعْنِی الْقَائِمَ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) وَ لَمْ یَقُلْ ابْنِی هَذَا.
4.fa: محمّدبن‌عمران گوید: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) شنیدم که فرمود: «می‌گویند هشت نفر از ما محدّثون خواهند بود و هفتمین آن‌ها حضرت قائم (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) است. ابوبصیر از جای برخاسته و سر مبارک آن حضرت را بوسید و گفت: «از چهل سال قبل این را از پدر بزرگوارتان امام باقر (علیه السلام) شنیدم و آن زمان‌که این حدیث را شنیدم پنج ساله بودم که آن حضرت این حدیث را بیان فرمود و گفت: «ای بچّه ساکت باش که مراد از لِیَزْدادُوا إِیماناً مَعَ إِیمانِهِمْ حضرت قائم (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) است و فرزند من این جمله را نفرمود».
4.en: Muhammad ibn Imran said: I heard Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) saying, "They say there are eight among us who are 'Muhaddathun' (those spoken to by angels), the seventh of whom is the Qa'im (may Allah hasten his noble relief)." Then Abu Basir ibn Abi al-Qasim stood up, kissed his head, and said, "I heard this from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) forty years ago." Abu Basir said to him, "I heard it from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) when I was a five-year-old boy, and he brought this forth." He (the Imam) said, "Be silent, O boy! [It refers to] 'that they may increase in faith along with their [present] faith' (48:4), meaning the Qa'im (may Allah hasten his noble relief)," and he did not say, "This is my son."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 426

4.ar: کَانَ کُلُ شَیْءٍ مَاءً وَ کانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْماءِ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ ذِکْرُهُ الْمَاءَ فَاضْطَرَمَ نَاراً ثُمَّ أَمَرَ النَّارَ فَخَمَدَتْ فَارْتَفَعَ مِنْ خُمُودِهَا دُخَانٌ فَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الدُّخَانِ وَ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ مِنَ الرَّمَادِ ثُمَّ اخْتَصَمَ الْمَاءُ وَ النَّارُ وَ الرِّیحُ فَقَالَ الْمَاءُ: أَنَا جُنْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَکْبَرُ وَ قَالَتِ الرِّیحُ: أَنَا جُنْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَکْبَرُ وَ قَالَتِ النَّارُ: أَنَا جُنْدُ اللَّهِ الْأَکْبَرُ. فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَی الرِّیحِ: أَنْتِ جُنْدِیَ الْأَکْبَر.
4.en: Everything was water, and His Throne was upon the water. Then Allah, Mighty is His mention, commanded the water, and it blazed into fire. Then He commanded the fire, and it extinguished, and from its extinguishing, smoke rose. Allah then created the heavens from that smoke and created the earth from the ash. Then the water, the fire, and the wind contended with one another. The water said, "I am the greatest soldier of Allah." The wind said, "I am the greatest soldier of Allah." And the fire said, "I am the greatest soldier of Allah." Then Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, revealed to the wind: "You are My greatest soldier."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 426

4.ar: وَ لِلهِ جُنُودُ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ یَعْنِی المَلَائِکَةُ وَ الْجِنُّ وَ الانْسُ وَ الشَّیَاطِینُ.
4.fa: وَ لِلهِ جُنُودُ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ؛ مراد از لشکریان آسمان‌ها و زمین، ملائکه، جن، انس و شیاطین می‌باشند.
4.en: "And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth," meaning the angels, the jinn, mankind, and the devils.
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 426

6.ar: وَ اللَّهِ مَا أُعْطِیَ مُؤْمِنٌ قَطُّ خَیْرَ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا بِحُسْنِ ظَنِّهِ بِاللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ رَجَائِهِ مِنْهُ وَ حُسْنِ خُلُقِهِ وَ الْکَفِّ عَنِ اغْتِیَابِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ ایْمُ اللَّهِ لَا یُعَذِّبُ اللَّهُ مُؤْمِناً بَعْدَ التَّوْبَةِ وَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ إِلَّا أَنْ یُسِیءَ الظَّنَّ بِاللَّهِ وَ تَقْصِیرِهِ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ وَ سُوءِ خُلُقِهِ وَ اغْتِیَابِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ اللَّهِ لَا یُحْسِنُ عَبْدٌ مُؤْمِنٌ ظَنّاً بِاللَّهِ إِلَّا کَانَ اللَّهُ عِنْدَ ظَنِّهِ بِهِ لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ کَرِیمٌ یَسْتَحْیِی أَنْ یُخْلِفَ ظَنَّ عَبْدِهِ وَ رَجَاءَهُ فَأَحْسِنُوا الظَّنَّ بِاللَّهِ وَ ارْغَبُوا إِلَیْهِ وَ قَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الظَّانِّینَ بِاللهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ عَلَیْهِمْ دائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ.
6.fa: به خداوند سوگند! هر مؤمنی که به خیر دنیا و آخرت رسید فقط به خاطر حسن ظن به خداوند بود. و با امیدواری و حسن خلق به آن مقام رسید و غیبت مردم را نکرد و زبان به بدگویی کسی نگشود. به خداوند سوگند! پروردگار مؤمنی را اگر توبه و استغفار کرده باشد، عذاب نمی‌کند. مگر اینکه به خداوند سوءظن داشته و به خدا امیدوار نبوده و از مؤمنان غیبت کرده باشد. به خدا سوگند! هر مؤمنی که به خدا حسن ظن داشته باشد خدا به حسن ظن او عمل می‌کند. و خداوند از اینکه حسن ظن و امید بنده‌ی مؤمن خود را بر نیاورد و او را ناامید کند، حیاء می‌کند. اینک به خداوند حسن ظن داشته و مشتاق باشید. که خداوند در قرآن فرموده است: الظَّانِّینَ بِاللهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ عَلَیْهِمْ دائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ.
6.en: By Allah, no believer has ever been granted the good of this world and the Hereafter except through his good opinion of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, his hope in Him, his good character, and refraining from backbiting the believers. By Allah, Allah does not punish a believer after repentance and seeking forgiveness unless he holds an evil opinion of Allah, falls short in his hope in Him, possesses bad character, and backbites the believers. By Allah, no believing servant holds a good opinion of Allah but that Allah is according to his opinion of Him, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, is Generous and is too shy to disappoint the opinion and hope of His servant. Therefore, have a good opinion of Allah and yearn toward Him, for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has said: "Those who think evil thoughts of Allah, against them is a turn of evil."
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 428
6.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 11, p. 248; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 67, p. 388 (with "bi-su'" as a variant for "yusi'u"); A'lam al-Din, p. 255; A'lam al-Din, p. 455; 'Uddat al-Da'i, p. 147; Fiqh al-Rida, p. 360 (with "bi-su'" as a variant for "an yusi'a")

6.ar: الظَّانِّینَ بِاللهِ ظَنَّ السَّوْءِ عَلَیْهِمْ دائِرَةُ السَّوْءِ هُمُ الَّذِینَ أَنْکَرُوا الصُّلْحَ وَ اتَّهَمُوا رسول الله (صلی الله علیه و آله).
6.fa: الظَّانِّینَ بِاللهِ ظَنَّ السَّوءِ عَلیْهِمْ دَائِرَةُ السَّوءِ منظور از این عبارت، کسانی هستند که با پیمان صلح از سوی رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) مخالفت و آن حضرت را متّهم کردند.
6.en: "Those who think evil thoughts of Allah—upon them is a misfortune of evil" (48:6): They are those who rejected the peace treaty and accused the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family).
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 428
6.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 20, p. 353; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 315; Al-Burhan

6.ar: فَإِنَّ فِی النَّاسِ مَنْ خَسِرَ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْآخِرَةَ یَتْرُکُ الدُّنْیَا لِلدُّنْیَا وَ یَرَی أَنَّ لَذَّةَ الرِّئَاسَةِ الْبَاطِلَةِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ لَذَّةِ الْأَمْوَالِ وَ النِّعَمِ الْمُبَاحَةِ الْمُحَلَّلَةِ فَیَتْرُکُ ذَلِکَ أَجْمَعَ طَلَباً لِلرِّئَاسَةِ حَتَّی إِذا قِیلَ لَهُ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ أَخَذَتْهُ الْعِزَّةُ بِالْإِثْمِ فَحَسْبُهُ جَهَنَّمُ وَ لَبِئْسَ الْمِهادُ فَهُوَ یَخْبِطُ خَبْطَ عَشْوَاءَ یَقُودُهُ أَوَّلُ بَاطِلٍ إِلَی أَبْعَدِ غَایَاتِ الْخَسَارَةِ وَ یُمِدُّهُ رَبُّهُ بَعْدَ طَلَبِهِ لِمَا لَا یَقْدِرُ عَلَیْهِ فِی طُغْیَانِهِ فَهُوَ یُحِلُّ مَا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ وَ یُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَا یُبَالِی بِمَا فَاتَ مِنْ دِینِهِ إِذَا سَلِمَتْ لَهُ رِئَاسَتُهُ الَّتِی قَدْ یَتَّقِی مِنْ أَجْلِهَا فَأُولَئِکَ الَّذِینَ غَضِبَ اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ لَعَنَهُمْ وَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذاباً مُهِینا.
6.en: Indeed, there are those among people who have lost both this world and the Hereafter. They abandon the world for the sake of the world, perceiving the pleasure of false leadership to be superior to the pleasure of permissible and lawful wealth and blessings. Thus, they forsake all of that in pursuit of leadership. When it is said to them, "Fear Allah," their arrogance drives them to sin; so Hell is sufficient for them, and how evil is the resting place! They stumble blindly, led by the first falsehood toward the furthest extremes of loss. After they seek what they cannot attain, their Lord increases them in their transgression. They declare lawful what Allah has forbidden and declare forbidden what Allah has made lawful. They do not care what is lost of their religion as long as their leadership—for which they may even feign piety—remains secure for them. These are those upon whom Allah has become angry, whom He has cursed, and for whom He has prepared a humiliating punishment.
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 428
6.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 84; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 71, p. 184; "shaqi" (wretched) is an alternative reading for "yattaqi" (he feigns piety).

6.ar: إِنَّ الَّتِی وَقَعَتْ عَلَیْهَا اسْمُ الْمُسُوخِیَّةِ مِثْلَ الْقِرْدِ وَ الْخِنْزِیرِ وَ الدُّبِّ وَ أَشْبَاهِهَا إِنَّمَا هِیَ مِثْلُ مَا مَسَخَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی صُوَرِهَا قَوْماً غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ لَعَنَهُمْ بِإِنْکَارِهِمْ تَوْحِیدَ اللَّهِ وَ تَکْذِیبِهِمْ رُسُلَهُ.
6.fa: امروزه در روی زمین مسخ‌شده‌ای نیست و آن‌ها را که منسوخ نامند مثل میمون و خوک و خرس و شبیهان آن‌ها؛ همانا مانند آن‌هایی هستند که خدا عزّوجلّ به قومی خشم کرد و آن‌ها را به این صورت درآورد و آن‌ها را به خاطر انکار یگانگی خدا و تکذیب رسولانش لعن کرد.
6.en: Those creatures upon whom the name of 'the transformed' (al-maskhuwwah) has fallen, such as the monkey, the swine, the bear, and their likes, are merely like those whom Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, transformed into their forms—a people upon whom Allah became angry and whom He cursed for their denial of the oneness of Allah and their rejection of His messengers.
6.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 430

9.ar: إِنَّا أَرْسَلْناکَ شاهِداً وَ مُبَشِّراً وَ نَذِیراً ثُمَّ عَطَفَ بِالْمُخَاطَبَةِ عَلَی أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ وَ تُعَزِّرُوهُ وَ تُوَقِّرُوهُ ثُمَّ عَطَفَ عَلَی نَفْسِهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فَقَالَ وَ تُسَبِّحُوهُ بُکْرَةً وَ أَصِیلاً مَعْطُوفاً عَلَی قَوْلِهِ لِتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللهِ وَ رَسُولِهُ.
9.fa: إِنَّا أَرْسَلنَاکَ شَاهِدًا و مُبَشِّرًا و نَذِیرًا؛ سپس اصحابِ پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) را مورد خطاب قرار داده و می‌فرماید: لتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللهِ و رَسُولهِ و تُعَزِّرُوهُ و تُوقِّرُوهُ و سپس خداوند بر ذات متعال خویش، عطف کرده و فرموده است: و تُسَبِّحُوهُ بُکْرَةً و أَصِیلا که این جمله به لتُؤْمِنُوا بِاللهِ و رَسُولهِ معطوف است.
9.en: "Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner." Then, He turns the address toward his companions and says: "That you may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect him." Then, He turns the address toward His own Self, the Almighty and Majestic, and says: "And exalt Him morning and afternoon," which is conjoined to His saying: "That you may believe in Allah and His Messenger."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 14, p. 430
